tasks.description: Ensure all storage, transport, and rendering layers declare and honor UTF-8 to prevent character corruption. This includes database, API, and frontend rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user enters a Unicode character, when the character is saved and rendered, then it is displayed correctly without corruption.

tasks.description: Modify the display name field to accept any Unicode script, including Latin, Japanese, Arabic, and others, without stripping or mangling characters.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user enters a display name in any Unicode script, when the name is saved and rendered, then it is displayed correctly without character loss or corruption.

tasks.description: Modify the layout, text alignment, and cursor behavior to support right-to-left languages like Arabic when the profile language is set to Arabic.
acceptance_criteria: Given the profile language is set to Arabic, when the user views their profile, then the layout, text alignment, and cursor behavior are correctly adjusted for RTL.

tasks.description: Ensure the bio field fully supports emoji, including multi-codepoint sequences and ZWJ sequences, and that they persist round-trip without corruption.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user enters an emoji in their bio, when the bio is saved and rendered, then the emoji is displayed correctly without corruption.

tasks.description: Modify the truncation logic for display names and bios to operate on grapheme clusters, ensuring that characters and emoji sequences are not split.
acceptance_criteria: Given a display name or bio exceeds its maximum length, when it is truncated, then the truncation occurs at a grapheme cluster boundary and an ellipsis is appended.

tasks.description: Review the entire stack to identify and fix any potential encoding issues that could lead to character corruption or incorrect rendering of Unicode characters and emoji.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user enters a variety of Unicode characters and emoji, when their profile is saved and rendered, then all characters and emoji are displayed correctly without corruption.

tasks.summary: Write unit tests for Unicode support
tasks.description: Create comprehensive unit tests to ensure the correct rendering and storage of Unicode characters and emoji across different browsers and devices.
acceptance_criteria: Given a set of test cases covering various Unicode scripts and emoji, when the tests are run, then all tests pass without errors.
